name: poly-fanout
description: Fanout matches melodic parent table[1..3], resolves only valid current-project/current-letter cache, and emits extras with stock gate and routing. Mismatched cache is silence, with no FatFS in the timing path. Global stock-pair admission checks the real shared scheduler occupancy before either insertion; a full ring rejects the complete new pair and preserves every queued off.

patches.note: real pair call -> chord fan-out cave
admit complete on/off pair only when the real ring has two free usable slots
full scheduler ring rejects new insertions without overwriting pending events
tie/slide admission before off cancellation; full ring preserves original off and skips replacement
